commits.subject: feat: show combo leg recommendation prices
fix: freeze required data across account scans

release_notes.text: Added direction-aware recommended prices to both Combo Yield legs in Daily Brief cards, using pipe-separated mobile-friendly lines and explicit unavailable states when a leg quote is missing.

Froze one immutable required-data snapshot and prepared portfolio context across every account in a shared scan, preventing later accounts from observing newer broker data or rebuilding inconsistent strategy evidence.
